{{Quote|Come out, come out, sly droids. To my eyes, hidden you are not.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], locating camouflaged chameleon droids through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]|<ref name="negd" />}}
The [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] '''chameleon droid''' was a [[Mine/Legends|mine]]-laying [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Originally [[Mining/Legends|mining]] exploration [[Droid/Legends|droids]] known as [[Spelunker probe droid/Legends|Spelunker probe droids]], they were outfitted with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], military grade mines, and a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] array for military service. The array worked by scanning the background and the angle of the viewer's sight, then [[Holoprojector/Legends|projecting a hologram]] of the background behind the droid, camouflaging it.

Chameleon droids were used throughout the Clone Wars. First deployed at the [[Ambush on Ilum]], the droids mined and heavily damaged the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]], albeit taking many casualties. The droids also saw use during the Confederacy's [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|subjugation]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], as well as in the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. Eventually, all chameleon droids were deactivated after the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|execution]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] at the close of the Clone Wars.

==Description==
[[File:Invisible-visible_droid.jpg|thumb|left|125px|A camouflaged chameleon [[Droid/Legends|droid]] becoming visible]]
The [[Class four droid/Legends|class four]] chameleon [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had four articulated pincer legs for traveling, as well as a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] to further support the weight of its cylindrical body.<ref name="negd" /> The legs could generate traction fields, allowing it to walk vertically and even upside down. The droids, which were able to survive in a wide range of climates, were dispatched to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] via [[Hyperdrive pod/Legends|hyperspace pods]].<ref name="db" />

Shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they were redesigned to serve in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. The chest [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] of the droid were removed and replaced with three [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The storage bay that contained its blasting charges for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] duty was left unchanged,<ref name="db" /> but the less potent explosives were replaced with twenty-four military grade [[fragmentation mine]]s.<ref name="TCWCG" /> It was also fitted with a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] array that could be used to camouflage the droid.<ref name="db" /> The array worked by scanning its surroundings and computing the location of viewers. After finishing these two tasks, it displayed a holographic screen of the backdrop behind it. However, if the viewer's angle was changed even slightly, the droid would be seen before it could correct itself.<ref name="negd" /> While not a true [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], it was nonetheless effective at fooling stationary visual sensor scans.<ref name="db" />

The chameleon droid's primary job was not as a front line [[Battle droid/Legends|combat unit]] but rather as a covert droid designed to sneak into enemy lines, lay [[Mine/Legends|mines]], and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] or [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] targets.<ref name="negd" /> A common tactic used by them was to lay down a large number of mines around the intended target while invisible and then open fire, with the intent to herd the enemy targets into the mined area.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==History==
===Manufacture and conversion===
The chameleon droid was originally the [[Spelunker probe droid/Legends|Spelunker probe droid]], a [[mining droid]] designed and built by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]], a major manufacturer of droids, heavy weapons, and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], the [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], a powerful [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] trade organization, bought thousands of them for exploration.<ref name="db" /> However, towards the end of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the Commerce Guild joined the newly formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] under the leadership of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Shu Mai brought the Spelunker design along with several others to be converted for military service, as she thought that the droids would become valuable mine layers. The Spelunker was overhauled and renamed the chameleon droid by several designers employed by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], another guild within the Confederacy. These conversions were in violation of the original production contract between Arakyd Industries and the Commerce Guild, which stated that the droids were not to be used for military purposes.<ref name="negd" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|You will find the temple on Ilum. Destroy it.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], ordering the droids to the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 16">{{CW|16}}</ref>}}
[[File:Jedifend.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] fend off chameleon droids.]]
The newly redesigned chameleon droids were ready for service approximately four months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning of the Clone Wars]], and the first opportunity for deployment presented itself when Dooku ordered the droids to the ice planet [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], the location of the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]], which was one of the only sources of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] vital to the construction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="cw16">''{{CW|16}}''</ref> The chameleon droids were ordered to destroy the caves in order to halt the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] production of lightsabers.<ref name="cwc">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume One|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume One]] director commentary</ref> They descended to the planet in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] pods and found the caves almost immediately. The droids began their assault just as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] was helping her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], construct her lightsaber. After sensing the presence of the intruders, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] counter-attacked, but were unable to prevent the droids from laying enough mines to heavily damage the caves. Nearby in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] sensed the two Jedi's peril at the Crystal Caves through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], predicting that they would die if not rescued soon. He and his companions, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], her [[Head of Security/Legends|Head of Security]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and his [[Counterpart/Legends|counterpart]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], plotted the most direct course for Ilum.<ref name="cw14" />

[[File:Yoda_cw15.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Chameleon droids surround [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in an attempt to kill the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].]]
After arriving on Ilum, Yoda left to rescue the Jedi, while Typho, Amidala, and the droids, guarded the ship. During his short journey to the caves, Yoda crushed a large number of chameleon droids in a Force-assisted avalanche.<ref name="cw15">''{{CW|15}}''</ref> Amidala became worried about Yoda when he failed to contact the group at a time which they had planned prior to their landing, and when Typho temporarily left her to check on the ship's [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]], Amidala took her two droids and fled in pursuit of Yoda. She destroyed several chameleon droids with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] on the way, using C-3PO and R2-D2 as distractions to reveal the locations of the cloaked droids. Yoda eventually returned to the ship with Amidala, the two rescued Jedi, and the droids. R2-D2 managed to recover a recording of the droids' orders, and the group learned that it was Dooku who had been behind the attack.<ref name="cw16" />

Chameleon droids were among the forces of the remaining Separatist presence on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and were employed against the Republic in the aftermath of the planet's [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|liberation]]. The Confederate [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Kul Teska]] used the last of the droid forces to distract the Republic in the ruined [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Resdin]] while he retrieved the [[Gravitic Core|core]] of his [[Gravitic polarization beam|newly-developed gravity weapon]], which had been stolen by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].<ref name="RH">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref> Some time later, in an effort to organize their increasingly large army, the [[Commerce Guild Punitive Security Forces/Legends|Commerce Guild Punitive Security Forces]] began to deploy chameleon droids in units of five, although sometimes up to twenty such units would be sent to deal with a particularly tough target. The [[Techno Union Droid Army/Legends|Techno Union Droid Army]] also grouped the droids in a similar fashion, but the maximum amount of units they would use in a single engagement was twelve.<ref name="TCWCG" />

At some stage, three chameleon droids operated their [[Holoprojector/Legends|holographic projectors]] on a desert planet. They were also [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|deployed]] on the vegetation-covered planet of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where three of them traveled cloaked in front of several [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]]. Eventually, the entire [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], which included all chameleon droids,<ref name="negd" /> was deactivated after the execution of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], bringing an end to the Clone Wars.<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The chameleon droid was first seen in [[Chapter 14 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|''Clone Wars Chapter 14'']], but no backstory was given for the droids, although it was revealed they had blasters, mines, and a cloaking device.<ref name="cw14" /> Later, ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' expanded on the droid and gave them a history.<ref name="negd" /> The ''New Essential Guide'' also provided images of the droids on two planets, one on Felucia, and the other on an unidentified desert planet. Since these images were not explained or captioned in any way, it is unknown at what time these events occurred.

The name of the droid may have been inspired by the in-universe [[chameleon creature]]. [[Wikipedia:Chameleon|Chameleons]] are also real-world animals.
